## Load Libraries

```{r load-libraries, message=F}
rm(list=ls())
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(readxl)
library(DESeq2)
library(sva)
library(pheatmap)
library(ggplot2)

# Source custom functions
source("transcriptomics_functions.R")

out_dir = "./export/"
```

```{r load-data-models, eval=FALSE}
# Step 1: Load data
data_list <- load_transcriptomics_data(
  counts_path = './data/count_data_all.csv',
  metadata_path = "./data/metadata_ecphage.xlsx",
  annotation_path = "./data/22ET500456__with-ecolik12.csv",
  metadata_filter_col = "comment",
  metadata_filter_pattern = "missing",
  fname_col = "fname"
)

counts <- data_list$counts
metadata <- data_list$metadata
annotation <- data_list$annotation

#Step 2: remove 8 mg/L samples across times
keep_samples <- metadata %>% filter(ab_conc!=8) %>% pull(fname)
metadata_filt <- metadata %>% filter(fname %in% keep_samples)
counts_filt <- counts[,metadata_filt$fname]
metadata_filt$ab_conc <- droplevels(metadata_filt$ab_conc)

#Step 2b: exclude A38 (24h) -- QC outlier. PC1 of the 24h VST-PCA is >4x the
#next most extreme sample, DESeq2-normalized library size (~2.9M) is roughly
#half of every other 24h sample, and a single gene (EBHIBJHK_04971) makes up
#11.7% of its library vs 3.6% average for other 24h samples. Raw mapping rate
#is normal (86.5%, best in the 24h batch), so this is a compositional/expression
#outlier, not a sequencing failure. Without exclusion, sva() partially fits this
#one sample and produces 24h DEG calls (phage, interaction) that barely overlap
#(Jaccard ~0.02-0.03) with the outlier-excluded model.
metadata_filt <- metadata_filt %>% filter(fname != "A38")
counts_filt <- counts_filt[, metadata_filt$fname]
```


```{r load-data-models, eval=FALSE}

models_outs <- file.path(out_dir,"model_out")

for (t in c("1h","4h","24h")){
  
  message(paste("--Identifying DEGs for: ", t))
  deseq_results <- run_DESeq2_sva(counts_filt, metadata_filt,formula_str = "~ ab_conc * phage", 
                             time_point = t)
   run_lfcShrink(deseq_results$dds, coef_name = "ab_conc_4_vs_0", annotation=annotation,
                          out_file = paste0(models_outs,"/venn_degs_",t,"_phage0-ab4.csv"),LFC=1,padj = 0.05)
   run_lfcShrink(deseq_results$dds, coef_name = "phage_1_vs_0", annotation=annotation,
                          out_file = paste0(models_outs,"/venn_degs_",t,"_phage1-ab0.csv"), LFC=1,padj = 0.05)
  
  run_lfcShrink(deseq_results$dds, coef_name = "ab_conc_4_vs_0", annotation=annotation,
                          out_file = paste0(models_outs,"/all_genes_",t,"_phage0-ab4.csv"))
  run_lfcShrink(deseq_results$dds, coef_name = "phage_1_vs_0", annotation=annotation,
                          out_file = paste0(models_outs,"/all_genes_",t,"_phage1-ab0.csv"))
  #interaction
  run_lfcShrink(deseq_results$dds, coef_name = "ab_conc4.phage1", annotation=annotation,
                          out_file = paste0(models_outs,"/all_genes_",t,"_abconc4.phage1.csv"))
  #combo ab+phage
  run_lfcShrink(deseq_results$dds, contrast_c=c( "ab_conc_4_vs_0","phage_1_vs_0", "ab_conc4.phage1")
                          , annotation=annotation,
                          out_file = paste0(models_outs,"/combo_",t,"_abconc4.phage1.csv"))
      
}
```

```{r}
library(vegan)
library(readr)
library(DESeq2)

# ── 1. Build VST distance matrix ───────────────────────────────
message("Building VST distance matrix...")

dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = counts_filt,
  colData = metadata_filt,
  design = ~1
)

# Filter low-count genes
keep <- rowSums(counts(dds) >= 10) >= 3
dds <- dds[keep, ]

dds <- estimateSizeFactors(dds)

# Variance Stabilizing Transformation
vst_counts <- vst(dds, blind = TRUE)
vst_mat <- t(assay(vst_counts))   # samples × genes

# Compute Euclidean distance
dist_obj <- dist(vst_mat, method = "euclidean")

# Convert dist object to full symmetric matrix
dist_matrix <- as.matrix(dist_obj)

# Optional: Ensure clean row and column names
rownames(dist_matrix) <- rownames(vst_mat)
colnames(dist_matrix) <- rownames(vst_mat)

# Save as TSV (proper matrix format)
write_tsv(
  as.data.frame(dist_matrix) %>% tibble::rownames_to_column("fname"),
  "./export/pcoa_vst_mat_euclidean.tsv",
  col_names = TRUE
)
write_tsv(
  metadata,
  "./export/metadata.tsv",
  col_names = TRUE
)
export_counts <- as.data.frame(t(counts_filt)) %>% tibble::rownames_to_column("fname")
write_tsv(
  export_counts,
  "./export/raw_counts.tsv",
  col_names = TRUE
)
message("Distance matrix successfully saved to 'pcoa_vst_mat_euclidean.tsv'")
```

## combo vs mono therapy
```{r}

source("transcriptomics_functions.R")
df_response <- assess_interactions(in_dir="./export/model_out/",
                                  out_dir = "./export/interaction/",
                                   annotation = annotation)


```

```{r}
rm(list = ls())
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggsankey)

df_gene <- read.csv("./export/interaction/combo_therapy_responses.csv")

# ==========================================================================
# TRUE GENE TRANSITION SANKEY (1h → 4h → 24h)
# ==========================================================================
# FIXES APPLIED:
#   BUG-1  edges_1 was built from a 3-way table(1h, 4h, 24h): the Freq
#          column counted triplets (unique 1h/4h/24h combos), not 1h→4h
#          pairwise flows. Var3 was silently dropped, inflating counts.
#          Fixed: use separate 2-way tables for each transition.
#
#   BUG-2  dplyr::first(na_rm = TRUE) is not a valid argument — na_rm
#          does not exist in dplyr::first(). Fixed: na.omit() wrapper.
#
#   BUG-3  "Shared (additive, no interaction)" category (added in
#          transcriptomics_functions_fixed.R) was missing from
#          classes_levels and class_cols, causing factor/color warnings.
#          Added with a distinct colour.
#
#   BUG-4  margins = margin(...) is not a valid theme() argument.
#          Fixed: plot.margin = margin(...).
#
#   BUG-5  size = .3 is deprecated for line geoms in ggplot2 ≥ 3.4.
#          Fixed: linewidth = .3.

# ── PARAMETERS ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
tp_levels <- c("1h", "4h", "24h", "END")   # END is a hidden sink stage

# BUG-3: added "Shared (additive, no interaction)" to match fixed classifier
classes_levels <- rev(c(
  "No significant change",
  "Antibiotic-driven (no interaction)",
  "Shared (additive, no interaction)",
  "Phage-driven (no interaction)",
  "Interaction-defined (Non-additive)"
))

nochange_label <- "No significant change"

# ── 1) COMPLETE GENE × TIME GRID ────────────────────────────────────────────
df_long_full <- df_gene %>%
  mutate(time_point = factor(time_point, levels = tp_levels[1:3])) %>%
  complete(gene, time_point, fill = list(response_class = nochange_label)) %>%
  group_by(gene, time_point) %>%
  summarise(
    # BUG-2: dplyr::first() has no na_rm argument; use na.omit() wrapper
    response_class = dplyr::first(na.omit(response_class)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# ── 2) WIDE FORMAT ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
df_wide <- df_long_full %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = time_point, values_from = response_class)

# ── 3) REMOVE GENES ALWAYS "NO CHANGE" ──────────────────────────────────────
df_wide <- df_wide %>%
  filter(!if_all(all_of(tp_levels[1:3]), ~ .x == nochange_label))

# ── 4) BUILD TRANSITIONS ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# BUG-1: each transition uses its own 2-way table; no Var3 / triplet issue.

edges_1 <- as.data.frame(table(`1h` = df_wide$`1h`, `4h` = df_wide$`4h`)) %>%
  rename(node = `X1h`, next_node = `X4h`, value = Freq) %>%
  mutate(x = "1h", next_x = "4h")

edges_2 <- as.data.frame(table(`4h` = df_wide$`4h`, `24h` = df_wide$`24h`)) %>%
  rename(node = `X4h`, next_node = `X24h`, value = Freq) %>%
  mutate(x = "4h", next_x = "24h")

edges <- bind_rows(edges_1, edges_2) %>%
  filter(value > 0) %>%
  mutate(
    x         = factor(x,         levels = tp_levels),
    next_x    = factor(next_x,    levels = tp_levels),
    node      = as.character(node),
    next_node = as.character(next_node)
  )

# ── 5) ADD OUTGOING EDGES FROM 24h → END (forces 24h nodes to render) ───────
edges_end <- edges %>%
  filter(next_x == "24h") %>%
  group_by(next_node) %>%
  summarise(value = sum(value), .groups = "drop") %>%
  transmute(
    x         = factor("24h", levels = tp_levels),
    next_x    = factor("END", levels = tp_levels),
    node      = as.character(next_node),
    next_node = "__END__",
    value     = value
  )

edges_plot <- bind_rows(edges, edges_end) %>%
  mutate(
    node      = factor(node,      levels = c(classes_levels, "__END__")),
    next_node = factor(next_node, levels = c(classes_levels, "__END__"))
  )

# ── 6) COLORS ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# BUG-3: "Shared (additive, no interaction)" given its own colour
class_cols <- c(
  "No significant change"                 = "#BFC9D1",
  "Antibiotic-driven (no interaction)"    = "#48A111",
  "Shared (additive, no interaction)"     = "#F4A824",
  "Phage-driven (no interaction)"         = "#3396D3",
  "Interaction-defined (Non-additive)"    = "#C40C0C",
  "__END__"                               = "transparent"
)

# ── 7) PLOT ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
p <- ggplot(
  edges_plot,
  aes(
    x         = x,
    next_x    = next_x,
    node      = node,
    next_node = next_node,
    value     = value,
    fill      = node
  )
) +
  geom_sankey(flow.alpha = 0.6, node.color = NA) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = class_cols,
    breaks = setdiff(names(class_cols), "__END__")
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    labels = c("1h" = "1h", "4h" = "4h", "24h" = "24h"),
    expand = expansion(add = c(0.1, 0.1))
  ) +
  labs(x = "Time Point", y = "") +
  theme_sankey() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x    = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.position  = "top",
    legend.title     = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 9, face = "bold"),
    legend.text      = element_text(size = 9),
    legend.margin    = margin(t = 3, r = 0, b = 3, l = 0, unit = "pt"),
    plot.margin      = margin(t = 0, r = 0, b = 0, l = 0, unit = "pt"),  
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(
      linetype  = "longdash",
      linewidth = 0.3,       
      color     = "gray80"
    )
  ) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(
    title          = "Response Classes",
    ncol           = 4,
    title.position = "top"
  ))

ggsave("./figures/response_classes_sankey.pdf",  #
       plot   = p,
       device = "pdf",
       width  = 9,
       height = 6)

p

```


```{r}
library(patchwork)
library(ggh4x)

plot_combo_response_chicklets <- function(
  data_path,
  data = NULL,
  response_class,
  gene_category_path,
  gene_category = NULL,
  label_font_pt = 9,
  label_color = "#435663",
  color_set = c(phage = "#3396D3", ab = "#48A111", combo = "#982598",
                pos_inter = "#BF092F", neg_inter = "#0046FF"),
  label_set = c(ab = "Antibiotic Only", phage = "Phage Only",
                combo = "Antibiotic + Phage",
                neg_inter = "Negative Interaction",
                pos_inter = "Positive Interaction"),
  padj_cutoff = 0.05,
  timepoint = NULL,
  data_cols = c("lfc_ab", "lfc_phage", "lfc_combo", "lfc_interaction"),
  widths = c(4, 2),
  legend_position = "bottom",
  legend_nrow = 1,
  legend_spacing_mm = 1,
  facet_ncol = 1,
  tag = tag
) {
  # ---- deps (no attach) ----
  stopifnot(requireNamespace("dplyr", quietly = TRUE))
  stopifnot(requireNamespace("tidyr", quietly = TRUE))
  stopifnot(requireNamespace("ggplot2", quietly = TRUE))
  stopifnot(requireNamespace("readr", quietly = TRUE))
  stopifnot(requireNamespace("ggtext", quietly = TRUE))
  stopifnot(requireNamespace("xfun", quietly = TRUE))
  stopifnot(requireNamespace("grid", quietly = TRUE))
  stopifnot(requireNamespace("patchwork", quietly = TRUE))
  stopifnot(requireNamespace("ggh4x", quietly = TRUE))
  stopifnot(requireNamespace("force_panelsizes", quietly = TRUE) ||
              requireNamespace("lemon", quietly = TRUE) ||
              TRUE) # only used if installed
  # geom_chicklet package varies; keep as-is (assumes it is loaded by user)
  if (!exists("geom_chicklet", mode = "function")) {
    stop("geom_chicklet() not found. Load the package that provides it (e.g., ggchicklet).")
  }

  # ---- read input ----
  if (is.null(data)) {
    data <- readr::read_csv(data_path, show_col_types = FALSE)
  }

  if (is.null(gene_category) && !is.null(gene_category_path)) {
    if (file.exists(gene_category_path)) {
      gene_category <- utils::read.csv(gene_category_path)
    } else {
      gene_category <- NULL
    }
  }

  # ---- filter + rename + padj-gating ----
  df <- data %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data$response_class == !!response_class & !is.na(locus_tag)) %>%
    dplyr::rename(gene_name = `gene.y`) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      lfc_phage       = ifelse(.data$padj_phage       < padj_cutoff, .data$lfc_phage,       0),
      lfc_ab          = ifelse(.data$padj_ab          < padj_cutoff, .data$lfc_ab,          0),
      lfc_combo       = ifelse(.data$padj_combo       < padj_cutoff, .data$lfc_combo,       0),
      lfc_interaction = ifelse(.data$padj_interaction < padj_cutoff, .data$lfc_interaction, 0)
    )
  
  if(!is.null(timepoint)){
    df <- df %>% filter(time_point %in% timepoint)
  }
  
  lvls <- c("ab", "phage", "combo", "pos_inter", "neg_inter", "zero_inter")
  filter_col <- c("gene", "gene_name", "time_point", data_cols)

  # ---- pivot long ----
  df_piv <- df %>%
    dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(filter_col)) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(
      cols = dplyr::all_of(data_cols),
      names_to = "group",
      values_to = "LFC",
      names_prefix = "lfc_"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data$gene_name)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      group2 = ifelse(.data$group == "interaction", "I", "B"),
      group = dplyr::case_when(
        .data$group == "interaction" & .data$LFC > 0  ~ "pos_inter",
        .data$group == "interaction" & .data$LFC < 0  ~ "neg_inter",
        .data$group == "interaction" & .data$LFC == 0 ~ "zero_inter",
        TRUE ~ .data$group
      ),
      group = factor(.data$group, levels = lvls)
    )

  # ---- labels + ordering ----
  if (!is.null(gene_category)) {
    df_piv <- df_piv %>%
      merge(gene_category, by = "gene_name", all.x = TRUE) %>% distinct() %>%
      dplyr::arrange(.data$functional_group,.data$gene_name)
    
    write.csv(df_piv,paste0("./export/__response_calss_",sub(" ", "_", response_class),"_",paste0(timepoint, collapse='"-"'),".csv"))
    
    df_piv <- df_piv %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        gorder = dplyr::row_number(),
        label = paste0(
          "***", xfun::html_escape(.data$gene_name), "***",
          "<span style='font-size:", label_font_pt, "pt; color:", label_color, ";'> (",
          xfun::html_escape(.data$functional_group),
          ")</span>"
        )
      )
  } else {
    df_piv <- df_piv %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        gorder = dplyr::row_number(),
        label = paste0("***", xfun::html_escape(.data$gene_name), "***")
      )
  }
 
  # ---- panel heights ----
  height_df <- df_piv %>%
    dplyr::group_by(.data$time_point) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(n_genes = dplyr::n_distinct(.data$gene), .groups = "drop") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(height = .data$n_genes / min(.data$n_genes))

  # ---- shared theme + legend guide ----
 custome_theme <- ggplot2::theme(
  plot.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = 10),
  axis.title.y = ggplot2::element_text(size = 12,face="bold"),
  axis.title.x = ggplot2::element_text(size = 12,face = "bold"),
  axis.text.y = ggtext::element_markdown(size = 9),
  axis.text.y.left = ggtext::element_markdown(size = 11),
  axis.text.y.right = ggtext::element_markdown(size = 9),
  plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(hjust = 0.5,size = 12,face = "bold"),
  legend.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = 10),
  legend.title = ggplot2::element_text(size = 9,face='bold'),
  panel.grid.minor.x = ggplot2::element_blank(),
  panel.grid.major.x = ggplot2::element_line(linetype = "dashed", linewidth = .4)
)


  legend_guide <- ggplot2::guides(
    fill = ggplot2::guide_legend(
      nrow = legend_nrow,
      byrow = TRUE,
      override.aes = list(alpha = 0.6, linewidth = 0, colour = NA)
    )
  )

  # ---- left plot (B) ----
  dleft <- df_piv %>% dplyr::filter(.data$group2 == "B")

  p_left <- ggplot2::ggplot(dleft, ggplot2::aes(x = reorder(.data$label, .data$gorder),
                                               y = .data$LFC, color = .data$group, fill = .data$group)) +
    geom_chicklet(
      ggplot2::aes(x = reorder(.data$label, .data$gorder), y = .data$LFC, color = .data$group),
      position = ggplot2::position_dodge2(reverse = TRUE, padding = 0.3),
      size = .3, fill = "white", width = 0.8, radius = grid::unit(2, "pt"),
      na.rm = TRUE, show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    geom_chicklet(
      ggplot2::aes(x = reorder(.data$label, .data$gorder), y = .data$LFC, color = .data$group, fill = .data$group),
      alpha = 0.8,
      position = ggplot2::position_dodge2(reverse = TRUE, padding = 0.3),
      width = 0.8, size = .3, radius = grid::unit(2, "pt"),
      na.rm = TRUE, show.legend = TRUE
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey60", linewidth = 0.5, linetype = "dashed") +
    ggplot2::facet_wrap(~time_point, scales = "free_y", ncol = facet_ncol) +
    ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(
      values = color_set,
      breaks = c("ab", "phage", "combo", "pos_inter", "neg_inter"),
      limits = c("ab", "phage", "combo", "pos_inter", "neg_inter"),
      drop = FALSE,
      labels = label_set,
      na.translate = FALSE,
      name = "Response classes"
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_color_manual(values = color_set, guide = "none") +
    ggplot2::labs(x = "Genes (Functional group)", title = "Treatment-specific effects",tag=tag,y="Log2(Fold Change)") +
    ggplot2::theme_minimal() + custome_theme +
    ggh4x::facetted_pos_scales(x = lapply(height_df$height, function(h) ggplot2::scale_x_discrete())) +
    ggh4x::force_panelsizes(rows = height_df$height) +
    ggplot2::coord_flip() +
    legend_guide

  # ---- right plot (I) ----
  dright <- df_piv %>% dplyr::filter(.data$group2 == "I")

  p_right <- ggplot2::ggplot(dright, ggplot2::aes(x = reorder(.data$label, .data$gorder),
                                                 y = .data$LFC, color = .data$group, fill = .data$group)) +
    geom_bar(aes(x = reorder(.data$label, .data$gorder,color = .data$group, fill = .data$group,y = .data$LFC)), stat='identity',
      position = ggplot2::position_dodge2(reverse = TRUE, padding = 0.3),alpha = 0.6,
       width = 0.3, radius = grid::unit(2, "pt"),
      na.rm = TRUE, show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    # geom_chicklet(
    #   ggplot2::aes(x = reorder(.data$label, .data$gorder), y = .data$LFC, color = .data$group),
    #   position = ggplot2::position_dodge2(reverse = TRUE, padding = 0.3),
    #   size = .3, fill = "white", width = 0.1, radius = grid::unit(2, "pt"),
    #   na.rm = TRUE, show.legend = FALSE
    # ) +
    # geom_chicklet(
    #   ggplot2::aes(x = reorder(.data$label, .data$gorder), y = .data$LFC, color = .data$group, fill = .data$group),
    #   alpha = 0.6,
    #   position = ggplot2::position_dodge2(reverse = TRUE, padding = 0.3),
    #   width = 0.1, size = .1, radius = grid::unit(2, "pt"),
    #   na.rm = TRUE, show.legend = TRUE
    # ) +
    ggplot2::geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey60", linewidth = 0.5, linetype = "dashed") +
    ggplot2::facet_wrap(~time_point, scales = "free_y", ncol = facet_ncol) +
    ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(
      values = color_set,
      breaks = c("ab", "phage", "combo", "pos_inter", "neg_inter"),
      limits = c("ab", "phage", "combo", "pos_inter", "neg_inter"),
      drop = FALSE,
      labels = label_set,
      na.translate = FALSE,
      name = "Response classes"
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_color_manual(values = color_set, guide = "none") +
    ggplot2::labs(x = "", title = "Interaction effect",y="\u0394Log2(Fold Change)") +
    ggplot2::theme_minimal() + custome_theme +
    ggplot2::theme(axis.text.y.left = ggplot2::element_blank(),
                   axis.ticks.y = ggplot2::element_blank(),plot.tag = element_blank()) +
    ggh4x::facetted_pos_scales(x = lapply(height_df$height, function(h) ggplot2::scale_x_discrete())) +
    ggh4x::force_panelsizes(rows = height_df$height) +
    ggplot2::coord_flip() +
    legend_guide

  # ---- combine ----
  p_compact <- (p_left | p_right) +
    patchwork::plot_layout(widths = widths, guides = "collect") &
    ggplot2::theme(
      legend.position = legend_position,
      legend.box = "horizontal",
      legend.spacing = grid::unit(legend_spacing_mm, "mm")
    )

  list(
    plot = p_compact,
    df_piv = df_piv,
    p_left = p_left,
    p_right = p_right,
    height_df = height_df
  )
}
```

```{r}
library(readr)

  standardize_gene_col <- function(df) {
    # Common DESeq2 csv patterns: gene, Gene, rownames stored as X or Row.names
    gene_candidates <- c("gene", "Gene", "ID", "Row.names", "row.names", "X", "X1")
    found <- gene_candidates[gene_candidates %in% colnames(df)]
    if (length(found) == 0) {
      stop("Could not find a gene column in input. Columns: ", paste(colnames(df), collapse=", "))
    }
    gene_col <- found[1]
    df <- df %>% dplyr::rename(gene = !!gene_col)
    df
  }
  
  prep_res <- function(df, prefix) {
    df <- standardize_gene_col(df)
    
    req <- c("gene", "log2FoldChange", "padj")
    missing <- setdiff(req, colnames(df))
    if (length(missing) > 0) {
      stop("Missing required columns: ", paste(missing, collapse=", "),
           " in file with prefix ", prefix)
    }
    
    df %>%
      dplyr::select(gene, log2FoldChange, padj) %>%
      # enforce 1 row per gene (protect against prior merges/duplicates)
      dplyr::group_by(gene) %>%
      dplyr::slice(1) %>%
      dplyr::ungroup() %>%
      dplyr::rename(
        !!paste0("lfc_", prefix) := log2FoldChange,
        !!paste0("padj_", prefix) := padj
      )
  }
  
  
t<- "4h"
in_dir = "./export/model_out/"
results = list()
for( t in c("1h","4h","24h")){
  f_phage <- file.path(in_dir, paste0("all_genes_", t, "_phage1-ab0.csv"))
  f_ab <- file.path(in_dir, paste0("all_genes_", t, "_phage0-ab4.csv"))
  f_int <- file.path(in_dir, paste0("all_genes_", t, "_abconc4.phage1.csv"))
  f_combo <- file.path(in_dir, paste0("combo_", t, "_abconc4.phage1.csv"))
  
  res_phage <- read_csv(f_phage, show_col_types = FALSE)
  res_ab    <- read_csv(f_ab,   show_col_types = FALSE)
  res_int   <- read_csv(f_int,   show_col_types = FALSE)
  res_combo   <- read_csv(f_combo,   show_col_types = FALSE)
  
  phage_short <- prep_res(res_phage, "phage")
  ab_short    <- prep_res(res_ab,    "ab")
  int_short   <- prep_res(res_int,   "interaction")
  combo_short <- prep_res(res_combo,   "combo")
  
  annot <- annotation %>% select(ID,gene) %>% rename("gene_name"="gene","gene"="ID")
  res_all <- phage_short %>%
    full_join(ab_short, by = "gene") %>%
    full_join(int_short, by = "gene")%>%
    full_join(combo_short, by = "gene") %>% 
    merge(annot,by = "gene",all.x=T)
  
  results[[t]] <- res_all
  
}

df_results <- results |>
    tibble::enframe(name = "time_point", value = "response_data") |>
    tidyr::unnest(response_data)
 
res_sel <- df_results %>% merge(df_category,by='gene_name')
```

```{r}
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(ggplotify)
# Mask non-significant values → set to NA where padj >= 0.05
sig_df <- res_sel %>%
  mutate(
    lfc_ab_sig         = if_else(padj_ab < 0.05,         lfc_ab,         NA_real_),
    lfc_phage_sig      = if_else(padj_phage < 0.05,      lfc_phage,      NA_real_),
    lfc_interaction_sig = if_else(padj_interaction < 0.05, lfc_interaction, NA_real_),
    lfc_combo_sig      = if_else(padj_combo < 0.05,      lfc_combo,      NA_real_)
   ) %>%
  # Select only the sig columns + identifiers
  select(time_point,gene_name, group, ends_with("_sig")) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  filter(
    !if_all(starts_with("lfc_"), is.na)
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = c(time_point),
    values_from = ends_with("_sig"),
    names_sep = "_",
    values_fill = NA_real_
  ) %>% arrange(group)

mat <- sig_df %>%
  column_to_rownames("gene_name") %>%
  select(starts_with("lfc_")) %>%   # only the LFC sig columns
  as.matrix()


col_info <- data.frame(
  col_name = colnames(mat),
  time_point = sub(".*_(1h|4h|24h)$", "\\1", colnames(mat)),
  contrast   = sub("lfc_(.*?)_sig_.*", "\\1", colnames(mat))
) %>%
  mutate(
    time_point = factor(time_point, levels = c("1h", "4h", "24h")),
    contrast   = factor(contrast, 
                        levels = c("ab", "phage", "combo", "interaction"))
  )
ordered_col <- order(col_info$time_point, col_info$contrast)
mat_sorted <- mat[, col_info$col_name[ordered_col]]

colnames(mat_sorted) <- sub("^lfc_(.*?)_sig_(.*)$", "\\1", colnames(mat_sorted)) %>%
  str_to_title() %>%                             # Ab
  str_replace("Ab", "AB") %>% 
  str_replace("Phage", "P")%>% 
  str_replace("Combo", "AB+P") %>% 
  str_replace("Interaction", "I")          

# Row split vector (must match row order of mat)
row_split <- sig_df %>%
  distinct(gene_name, group) %>%
  right_join(tibble(gene_name = rownames(mat_sorted)), by = "gene_name") %>% 
  arrange(match(gene_name, rownames(mat_sorted))) %>%
  pull(group)


unique_groups <- unique(row_split)
n_groups <- length(unique_groups)

g_colors <- brewer.pal(length(unique_groups), name = "Set3")
group_colors <- setNames(g_colors,unique_groups)

wrapped_labels <- sapply(unique_groups, function(txt) {
  # Simple wrap: break after ~15–20 chars or at space
  paste(strwrap(txt, width = 20), collapse = "\n")
})

row_anno <- rowAnnotation(
  gene_group = anno_block(
    gp = gpar(fill = group_colors,alpha=0.4),
   width = max_text_width(wrapped_labels) + unit(2, "mm"),
    labels = wrapped_labels,
    labels_gp = gpar(col = "#37353E", fontsize = 6, fontface = "bold"),
    labels_rot = 0,
  ),

  show_annotation_name = FALSE
)

max_lfc <- max(abs(mat_sorted), na.rm = TRUE)
col_fun <- colorRamp2(c(-5,-4,-0.5,0,0.5,4,5),
                      c("#001BB7","#0046FF","#008BFF","#FFD150","#FF9B00","#F63049","#740A03"))

ht <- Heatmap(
  mat_sorted,
  name = "LFCs",
  col = col_fun,
  na_col = "#FFFCFB",
  
  row_split = row_split,
  row_names_side = "left",
  cluster_row_slices = FALSE,     
  cluster_rows = FALSE, 
  right_annotation = row_anno,
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 5,fontface='italic'),
  row_title = NULL,
  row_gap = unit(1, "mm"),
  row_names_rot = 0,
  # === Column split by time_point ===
  column_split = col_info$time_point[ordered_col],
  cluster_columns = FALSE,
  cluster_column_slices = FALSE,
  column_title = levels(col_info$time_point),
  column_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8, fontface = "bold"),
  column_names_side = "bottom",
  column_names_rot =-90,
  column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 7),
  
  rect_gp = gpar(col = "grey50", lwd = 0.5),
  
  heatmap_legend_param = list(
    title = "Log2(Fold Change)",
    direction = "horizontal",
    title_position = "lefttop",
    title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 7),
    labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 7)
    #at = c(-5,-2,-1,0,1,2,5),  
    #labels = c(-5,-2,-1,0,1,2,5)
  )
)

# 4. Draw the heatmap
```
